name: Grw
description:
Grw gets your whole team selling like your best rep. Taylor — the AI teammate inside Grw that builds and runs your sales systems — runs the work behind every deal, and this connector brings her into Claude.

Ask Claude about your deals and Taylor answers from your team's real data: she preps you for meetings, drafts follow-ups from call transcripts, updates your CRM so it can finally be trusted, and chases the deals that have gone quiet. Search and update deals, accounts, and contacts across HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho, Attio, and NetSuite; pull meeting recordings, transcripts, and clips; message your team in Slack or Microsoft Teams; and run or schedule the workflows your team already uses — one playbook, running across the team.

For bigger, judgement-heavy asks — "what should I focus on this week?", "draft a plan to close the Acme renewal" — the Ask Taylor tool hands the task to Taylor's full agent loop, and Claude retrieves her synthesized answer.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Grw to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Grw to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.grw.ai/api/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Grw MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grw lists 80 MCP tools, including alertTeam, ask_taylor, associate_crm_objects, createNote, createScript, createSkill, create_crm_object, create_notetaker_capture_clip, create_share_link, deleteNote, deleteScript, and deleteSkill.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Grw?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Grw in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Grw requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Grw is developed by Grw. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
